subject.title: Conversational agent lane wedges indefinitely: ingress events never reconcile (re-delivery storm on reconnect) + abort_embedded_run leaves owner lock unreleased (released=0)

question: Should maintainers accept the open bounded durable replay fix and its public channel-outbound SDK/dead-letter policy as the resolution for the remaining WhatsApp ingress replay storm?
rationale: The owner-lock half is already fixed on main, but the remaining fix changes public Plugin SDK surface and message-delivery failure behavior, which automation should not decide.

options.title: Accept the candidate fix
options.body: Land or continue reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365 as the canonical resolution for the remaining replay-storm bug, including the five-attempt dead-letter policy.

options.title: Narrow the SDK surface
options.body: Ask the PR to keep the replay helper internal while preserving the WhatsApp bounded replay behavior through a private channel seam.

options.title: Split operator recovery
options.body: Keep the bug fix separate and track inspect/drain/ack operator tooling as a follow-up product design item.

recommendation.title: Accept the candidate fix
recommendation.body: Land or continue reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365 as the canonical resolution for the remaining replay-storm bug, including the five-attempt dead-letter policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent channel runtime history and the candidate PR discussion point to vincentkoc for the message-delivery and inbound replay policy decision.
